boundary: Released Flink 2.2.1, JDK17, parallelism1, fresh JVM per profile run. Complete jobs include SQL planning/submission, runtime rowwise source, both native perimeter transposes, JNI/JVM work and rowwise blackhole sink. Fixture registration, explanations and metrics assertions are outside timing. Alternate engines within every trial; 1M/5M rows, half nullable TIMESTAMP_LTZ(9), 2warmup3trials or3warmup7trials as recorded. No concurrent local compiles/tests during timed runs. Native execution is established by plans and consumed-row counters; the final candidate executes one fused Calc. Prior executes host fallback. Raw completed profiles, including unfavorable candidates and trials, are retained. Unpinned CPU, local single-worker experiment, not a general throughput guarantee.
